text_blocks.snippet: Fabry disease symptoms include pain, skin rashes, sweating abnormalities, and gastrointestinal issues, with potential for more severe complications like kidney and heart problems. Symptoms vary widely, even among individuals with the same genetic mutation.
snippet_highlighted_words: pain, skin rashes, sweating abnormalities, and gastrointestinal issues

list.snippet: Pain: Burning, tingling, or pain in the hands and feet (acroparesthesia) is a frequent early symptom.
Skin Rashes: Small, dark red or purple spots (angiokeratomas) can appear on the skin, particularly on the lower trunk and genital area.
Sweating Abnormalities: Reduced ability to sweat (hypohidrosis) or no sweating at all (anhidrosis) can lead to overheating and temperature sensitivity.
Gastrointestinal Issues: Diarrhea, constipation, abdominal pain, and nausea are common.
Hearing Loss and Tinnitus: Ringing in the ears and hearing impairment can occur.
Eye Problems: Cloudiness in the cornea (corneal verticillata) can affect vision.
